title: trust anchor pathLen constraint not enforced in validate_chain()
description: cert.rs:validate_chain() checks pathLen of intermediate CAs found in the bag, but when a trust anchor is found as the issuer (lines 80-106), the code only verifies the signature and returns Ok without checking whether the trust anchor's own pathLen constraint is satisfied. Trigger: Root CA with pathLen=0 in trust_anchors, chain is Root→IntermCA→EE with IntermCA in the cert bag. The chain should be rejected (pathLen=0 permits no intermediate CAs below root), but the current code accepts it. RFC 5280 §4.2.1.9: pathLenConstraint gives the maximum number of non-self-issued intermediate certificates that may follow this certificate.
close_reason: Fixed: validate_chain() now checks the trust anchor's own pathLen constraint before returning Ok().
